messages:
Maya Chen: Hey folks — doing a little WFH purge this weekend. Got a barely-used curved 32" monitor (USB-C single cable), a small adjustable tripod desk lamp, and a partially used SF Muni monthly pass (about 10 rides left). Free to whoever picks up in SOMA. Pics: https://imgur.com/example

Jonah Patel: Ooh nice. USB-C power/dp alt mode only or has DisplayPort?

Maya Chen: USB-C alt mode and one HDMI. Runs at 1440p 100hz. No dead pixels I could find.

Samir Gupta: I might take the pass if nobody objects — commute is a mess next week. Can pickup Sat morning.

Priya Singh: Lamp for me? adjustable brightness and goes flat for travel?

Maya Chen: Lamp folds flat, dimmable, battery lasts ~6h. Priya you good to pick up Sat 11-12? Address: `123 Townsend St, Suite 400` curbside.

Dana Lopez: I can grab the monitor if still available. Will be in SF on Sat around noon. DM me your phone Maya. :raised_hands: 

Maya Chen: Cool — Dana for monitor, Priya lamp, Samir pass. DM me and I’ll send exact unit number. If anyone else needs it and plans change, shout here.

OfficeBot: Reminder: please avoid leaving company property in public areas. These are personal items; coordinate directly and remove same day.

Jonah Patel: Haha yeah not leaving it on the bench. Thanks for the share Maya :heart:

Maya Chen: Updated: everything spoken for. If any of the three fall through I’ll post here. Thanks y'all! :wave:
